Question:
What is the volume of a cone with base area 9 and height 3?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h111_q3_question_en.svg)
Solution: The volume of a pyramid or cone is one third that of a prism or cylinder with the same base area and height: \(9\times3/3=9\).
